title: C++ Programming
description: Modern C++ engineering covering OOP, STL algorithms, move semantics, template metaprogramming, and production application building.
outcomes: Master fundamental to advanced concepts in C++ Programming.
Build industry-standard applications and capstone projects.
Excel in technical interviews and competitive programming.

modules.title: Getting Started & C++ Environment
modules.description: C++ history, compiler toolchains (GCC/Clang/MSVC), compilation process, basic syntax, structure of a C++ program, and standard I/O.

modules.title: Variables, Constants & Fundamental Data Types
modules.description: Primitive types (int, float, double, char, bool), type modifiers (signed, unsigned, short, long), sizeof operator, type casting, and constant qualifiers.

modules.title: Operators & Mathematical Expressions
modules.description: Arithmetic, relational, logical, bitwise, assignment, increment/decrement operators, operator precedence, and associativity.

modules.title: Input/Output Operations & Math Library
modules.description: Interactive input with std::cin, buffer management, escape sequences, formatting with <iomanip>, and math functions in <cmath>.

modules.title: Conditional Statements & Decision Making
modules.description: if, if-else, nested if-else, else-if ladder, conditional operator, switch-case statements, and decision flow control.

modules.title: Loops & Iterative Control
modules.description: while loops, do-while loops, for loops, nested loops, break, continue, loop optimization, and infinite loop prevention.

modules.title: Functions & Recursion
modules.description: Function declarations, definitions, return types, parameter passing (pass by value vs reference), default arguments, function overloading, and recursion.

modules.title: Arrays & Dynamic Vectors
modules.description: 1D arrays, multi-dimensional/2D arrays, array traversal, memory layout, bounds checking, and std::vector basics.

modules.title: Strings & Text Processing
modules.description: C-style character arrays vs std::string, string member functions, traversal, manipulation, substrings, concatenation, and search operations.

modules.title: Pointers, References & Memory Management
modules.description: Pointer syntax, address-of (&) and dereference (*) operators, pointer arithmetic, pointers with arrays, references, dynamic memory allocation with new/delete, and memory leaks.

modules.title: Structures, Unions & Enumerations
modules.description: Custom composite data types, struct declaration and initialization, nested structures, unions, enum, and modern enum classes.

modules.title: Object-Oriented Programming: Classes & Objects
modules.description: OOP paradigm, classes, objects, data encapsulation, access specifiers (public, private, protected), constructors, destructors, and this pointer.

modules.title: Advanced OOP: Inheritance & Polymorphism
modules.description: Inheritance modes (single, multiple, multilevel, hierarchical), function overriding, virtual functions, abstract classes, pure virtual functions, and operator overloading.

modules.title: Exception Handling & File Streams
modules.description: try, catch, throw blocks, standard exception hierarchy, custom exceptions, file streams (<fstream>), ifstream, ofstream, reading and writing files.

modules.title: Standard Template Library (STL)
modules.description: STL containers (vector, list, deque, stack, queue, priority_queue, set, map, unordered_map), iterators, and core STL algorithms (sort, find, binary_search, reverse).

modules.title: Code Debugging & Common Pitfalls
modules.description: Diagnosing syntax errors, linker errors, runtime segmentation faults, memory leaks with valgrind, and test case analysis.

modules.title: Logic Building & Algorithmic Practice
modules.description: Mathematical algorithms, number theory drills, pattern printing, matrix transformations, and competitive programming challenges.

modules.title: Real-World C++ Capstone Projects
modules.description: End-to-end software applications including Student Record Management, Banking System, Console Arcade Games, and File Encryption utilities.
